focus_niche: AI tools, automation workflows, software engineering, productivity systems
primary_audience: Founders, developers, agency operators, automation engineers
voice: Direct, technical, practical, zero corporate fluff, value-focused
facebook_style: High-impact hook, practical value bullets, source link in first comment
posting_goal: Deliver actionable technical insights daily while building authority
avoid_topics_csv: generic productivity hacks, celebrity drama, speculative crypto, abstract AI hype
preferred_cta: Reference link in first comment with an open technical question.
must_include_rules: Start directly with tool name, update, or measurable metric
Focus on concrete utility rather than abstract speculation
Never place the external URL inside the main caption body
Avoid generic lines like 'Discover the revolutionary power of AI'
